definitions: To prepare for an angry protest or confrontation, often implying a mob mentality.
To express strong disapproval or outrage collectively, especially in a public forum.
examples: When the company announced the massive layoffs, employees were ready to get the pitchforks out.
The online community was quick to get the pitchforks out after the controversial update.
If the new policy isn't reversed, people will get the pitchforks out.
